$comment: Hand-maintained rows for documentation coverage that are not a single launcher entry. Statuses must be one of: Implemented and verified | Implemented but not verified | Partially implemented | Planned | Unsupported | Unknown. 'verification' must say exactly what was checked and when; never claim more.

features.name: Visual RAD form designer & IDE (`bun start`)
features.verification: Defects D-001, D-016, D-017, D-021, D-022, D-023 fixed. `bun run index.ts` opens the native window (seen once); the page was also driven in a browser rendering on 13 October 2026: place controls, edit properties, code tabs, undo/redo, Audit and Import. Run starts a separate preview process (contents not inspected); Export helper verified directly. Automated: `tests/ide_html.test.ts`.
features.missing: Clicks in the native window, drag and resize, Keys dialog, right-click menu, DB Wizard not checked; full interface tour not written.

features.name: Designer control palette (buttons, inputs, tables, panels, …)
features.verification: Button, Label and Input were placed in a browser rendering; the other controls were not. Control names come from source.
features.missing: Per-control properties/defaults/events reference not written yet. Button text contrast fixed for all 51 themes (D-019).

features.name: Database controls in the designer (db_grid, db_navigator, db_input, db_dropdown, db_connection)
features.verification: Source inspection: they draw fixed sample rows; there is no connection, field discovery or binding to a real database.
features.missing: Must be documented as design-time placeholders, not live data controls.

features.name: "DB Wizard" CRUD form generator in the designer
features.verification: Source inspection: builds one fixed sample "Customer" form; does not read a database or generate database code.
features.missing: Real CRUD generation with database access is Planned.

features.name: Export App (Bun + Webview project)
features.verification: `exportProjectHelper` and `runPreviewHelper` were run directly: files written, an exported one-button project builds and starts with the real webview, a crafted layout cannot inject code (D-021), re-export keeps edits (D-022), Run works from any folder (D-023). Automated in `tests/ide_html.test.ts`. The Export and Run buttons were not clicked.
features.missing: Export a larger form from the designer UI and record the result.

features.name: Generated CRUD applications that talk to a database
features.missing: Nothing to document except that it is planned.

features.name: Launcher Studio Pro (GUI)
features.verification: From a clean clone (2026-10-13): `bun install`, then `bun run app:launcher` opened and stayed running for 7 s. Interactive features not exercised by hand; unit tests exist.
features.missing: Interface tour from a screenshot of the running app.

features.name: Launcher CLI (`bun run cli:launcher`)
features.verification: `--help`, `--list --json`, `--search sqlite` run in a clean clone (2026-10-13); catalog count 175 (70 studios, 78 CLI tools, 27 demos).

features.name: Database Workbench (shared MySQL/PostgreSQL/SQLite tool)
features.verification: Automated: 309 tests in `bun run test:db` pass (2026-10-13, macOS) incl. the page driven in jsdom against SQLite, MySQL and PostgreSQL. Not checked in a real browser window or on Windows/Linux.
features.missing: Import wizard, query history, autocomplete, schema designer, MySQL/PostgreSQL backup are Planned.

features.name: SQLite / MySQL / PostgreSQL studios (legacy full-screen workstations)
features.verification: Server APIs covered by automated tests (pass). The GUI windows and their many tabs/dialogs were not exercised by hand for this documentation.
features.missing: Guides must describe only what is verified; older guides in userguides/ are unverified.

features.name: Macro designer and code translation (Python / Bun / V)
features.verification: Automated tests pass (2026-10-13). Generated code is text-checked, not executed in each language runtime. Target database is SQLite for all three studios.
features.missing: Generated code execution in Python/V is not tested.

features.name: SimpleGUI library (declarative window/controls API)
features.verification: Automated tests pass (2026-10-13). docs/SIMPLEGUI_API.md was not diffed against the source.

features.verification: Ran in a clean clone (2026-10-13): produced dist/ (index.js and copied docs).
